Single variable: cap-aware post-sizing risk top-up for `trend_long` and `breakout_long` non-ETF/non-commodity stock signals whose signal-day ticker-minus-sector-proxy return is in the same-day top quartile. gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: core risk allocation: top-quartile signal-day ticker-vs-sector thrust identifies stronger idiosyncratic leaders among already-qualified signals.
gate_questions.2_history_check: Broad sector-relative strength >0 failed in exp-20260513-107; sector-tape positive/adverse variants in exp-20260512-106/107 failed or were underpowered. No current-stack top-quartile sector-relative thrust scout was found.
gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: signal_day_sector_relative_thrust_risk_multiplier with fixed cross-sectional top-quartile state definition
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; aggregate EV/PnL positive, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed windows, survival >= 5%, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, nonzero adjustments.

similar_prior_results.exp-20260512-106: Rejected adverse sector-tape haircut; this run is positive idiosyncratic thrust, not a sector proxy threshold.
similar_prior_results.exp-20260512-107: Rejected fixed positive sector-proxy top-up; this run requires ticker outperformance versus the proxy.
similar_prior_results.exp-20260513-107: Rejected broad ticker-minus-sector-proxy > 0 top-up: aggregate EV -0.0002, late_strong regressed. This run tests a stronger top-quartile thrust state, not another nearby scalar on the same broad cohort.
similar_prior_results.latest_core_stack: Current baseline includes accepted price-vs-200MA, clean-SPY cap, RS20/RS60, own-green, and confirmed-quality allocation layers through exp-20260515-028.

historical_experiment_check.why_this_branch: The playbook asks for new production-visible allocation states after nearby cap/scalar wins became exhausted. This keeps the candidate set fixed and strengthens a previously underpowered state rather than relying on LLM soft-ranking or ticker expansion.

hypothesis: The broad signal-day sector-relative state failed because it admitted marginal beta. Restricting to the same-day top-quartile ticker-minus-sector-proxy thrust may isolate true idiosyncratic leadership among already-qualified core signals.
interpretation: Top-quartile signal-day sector-relative thrust did not clear the canonical three-window gate; do not promote this state variable on the frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: Use forward ticker-vs-sector thrust attribution or a different production-visible state before retrying sector-relative overlays.

state_definition.ticker_minus_sector_proxy: top 25% of feature-complete non-ETF/non-commodity stocks on the signal day

production_impact.promotion_requirement_if_accepted: Implement signal-day sector-relative thrust fields and sizing top-up in shared feature/risk/portfolio modules called by both run.py and backtester.py; add attribution keys and focused parity tests before live/default behavior changes.

rejection_reason: Top-quartile signal-day sector-relative thrust did not clear the canonical three-window gate; do not promote this state variable on the frozen windows.
single_causal_variable: cap-aware post-sizing risk top-up for trend/breakout stock signals whose signal-day ticker-minus-sector-proxy return is in the same-day top quartile
